title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows and optimize Node caching
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Refactor CI workflows: split lint/test/release into separate GitHub Actions, improve Actions cache keys for Node tooling, and consolidate a shared ci-common workflow. Expected win: ~25-35% reduction in median CI runtime for PRs, improved cache hit rates and clearer failure modes. No runtime behavior changes to production artifacts.
description:
Motivation: Our monolithic CI workflow has grown large and slow, with noisy failures and poor cache hit rates for Node-based jobs. This PR splits the pipeline into focused workflows (lint, test, release), extracts common steps to a shared ci-common.yml, and improves cache key generation for node_modules and tool caches. Goals: faster feedback for contributors, clearer signal when lint/test/release fail, and better cache reuse across matrix combinations.

What I changed (summary):
- Introduced .github/workflows/lint.yml (fast lint-only workflow triggered on PRs and push).
- Introduced .github/workflows/test.yml (unit/integration test matrix; parallel jobs for linux/mac/ubuntu-node versions).
- Introduced .github/workflows/release.yml (release automation separated to avoid running heavy jobs on regular PRs).
- Added .github/workflows/ci-common.yml to centralize checkout, node-setup cache logic, and common environment variables.
- Improved cache keys to include package-lock checksum and lockfileVersion + node-version to avoid cache pollution across node upgrades.
- Minor improvements to scripts/ci/setup-node.sh for idempotent setup and faster bootstrap.
- Updated docs/ci.md to document new workflow responsibilities and how to debug failed caches.

Checklist: 
- [x] Split workflows and verify triggers locally (act) where possible.
- [x] Run full test matrix on a feature branch to validate caching across node versions.
- [x] Validate release workflow does not run on non-release events.
- [x] Update CI docs and link to pipeline diagrams.

Testing performed:
- Ran test matrix on a dedicated branch; observed cache hit rate improvement from ~42% to ~79% for node_modules between subsequent runs.
- Fixed flaky test that surfaced during parallelization (test/db: ensure teardown runs even on errors).
- Verified lint workflow completes in ~45s median vs ~2m previously when running as part of the big combined workflow.

Rollout plan:
- Merge to main and monitor CI run durations and cache hit metrics (Grafana dashboard: infra.ci.pipeline.duration and infra.ci.cache_hits).
- Revert to consolidated workflow if we see increased flakes; but current run on release candidate pipeline looked stable.

Notes and trade-offs:
- Slight increase in total number of workflows and GH Actions runs (observable in billing) but significant reduction in PR feedback latency.
- Release workflow now runs only for release tags and release PRs to prevent accidental heavy runs.
- Kept matrix size for tests conservative: linux/mac + node 18/20. We can expand later if needed.

Related: ENG-5421 (CI performance), ENG-5490 (release automation hygiene).
